{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0 in biomarker_baseline)
sentinel_check = data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999.0).sum()

# Check for duplicate rows
duplicates = data.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'arm' column
treatment_count = data['arm'].value_counts()

# Check the 'responded' column
response_counts = data['responded'].value_counts()

# Print results
missing_values, sentinel_check, duplicates, treatment_count, response_counts"}
